title: wave start: spec-check questions can only be answered on a terminal, one at a time

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Observed 2026-11-11 (slicer wave): with stdin not a terminal, `ork wave start` read each spec-check question's answer from stdin; an empty read held the item, and a held item's later questions were never printed (s454's changelog.wave-entries question only appeared after its first question was answered). The questions are not in `ork status` (needs you 0) or `ork show`, and unanswered ones are not kept, so each retry re-asked from the start. An agent driving ork had to pipe answers blind by position (`printf '1\n2\n' | ork wave start ...`), and running the same items alone changed the question set (s454 asked 1 question instead of 2). Wanted: spec-check questions recorded as needs-you questions (all of them, including later ones), answerable with `ork answer`/`adj answer` by key, and kept across retries.

Re-anchored 2026-11-18. Most of this has landed since:

- S312 (adj 309 `specs.questions-wave-addressing`, adj 319 `specs.questions-json-shape`): `ork wave start --questions` lists every open question of every item, and `--answer ITEM:KEY=N` answers them in one call (`internal/cli/wave.go:606-640,641-680`).
- S404 (adj 452 `cli.spec-answers`): input that is not a terminal is never read for answers; ork prints every open question with its address and exits 3 (`internal/cli/wave.go:681-711`). This removes the blind pipe and prints a held item's later questions.
- The daemon keeps each item's verdict and questions in memory, keyed by the spec fingerprint (`specEntry`, `internal/daemon/speccheck.go:92-101`), so a retry with an unchanged spec gets the same questions without a new model call; a daemon restart asks again (`docs/design.md:370-379`, S143). Owner answers survive a restart in `answers.json` (`docs/state.md:430-438`).

What is left: open spec questions are still not in `ork status`. `projectStatus` counts open adj records, Needs-section runs and `needs-owner` items only (`internal/daemon/handlers.go:462-487`), and the status text lists only those (`internal/cli/daemoncmds.go:64-77`). S318 (`ork status --summary`, open) plans a Needs-you section that lists open spec-check questions, but only in the new summary view.

Open: whether this slice adds the questions to `ork status` and its needs-you count, or closes in favour of S318: per the owner's answer to `status.spec-questions`. Answering stays with `ork wave start --answer` / `ork run --answer` (adj 309, 452); a separate `ork answer` path for spec questions is not in this slice.

UI: `ork status` text and JSON change (`internal/cli` output), so this slice gets a UI pass (rule u10). The TUI Needs-you pane is not in this slice.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/speccheck.go:92-101` (`specEntry`: read the open questions of each remembered item)
- `internal/daemon/handlers.go:373-490` (`status` and `projectStatus`: list and count open spec questions)
- `internal/daemon/wire.go:110-130` (`ProjectStatus`: a `spec_questions` list)
- `internal/daemon/engine_runs_test.go`
- `internal/cli/daemoncmds.go:64-77` (status text: one line per item with open questions)
- `internal/cli/run_test.go`
- `docs/design.md` (status and spec check sections)
- `docs/guide.md` (where open spec questions show)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Written for option "status-list" (recommended); per the owner's answer to `status.spec-questions`.

- `TestStatusCountsOpenSpecQuestions` in `internal/daemon/engine_runs_test.go`: a daemon whose spec cache holds item S1 with two open questions (keys `a.b` and `c.d`) and item S2 ready. `status` returns `needs_you` 2 more than without them, and `spec_questions` holds one entry `{item: S1, keys: [a.b, c.d], list: "ork wave start P S1 --questions"}`. An item whose questions were all answered, or whose spec fingerprint no longer matches, is not listed. Red today: `projectStatus` does not read the spec cache.
- `TestStatusSpecQuestionsWaitingOnAdjAreNotCounted` in `internal/daemon/engine_runs_test.go`: an item held on an open adj record (`waitsOn`) is not counted twice: its adj record already counts. Red today: no field.
- `TestStatusPrintsOpenSpecQuestions` in `internal/cli/run_test.go`: the text output has `  S1  2 open spec questions: a.b, c.d (answer: ork wave start P S1 --questions)` under the project line. Red today: no such line.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests and see each red for the stated reason.
2. Per the owner's answer to `status.spec-questions`. With "status-list" (recommended): under the runs lock, read `d.runs.specs` for the project; an entry with open questions, not ready and not waiting on adj, becomes one `SpecQuestions` entry (item, keys, the command to list them). Count each open question in `NeedsYou`. With "close": do not implement; S318 lists them, and this slice is closed with a note.
3. Status text: print one line per item, after the open adj records and the held items.
4. Do not persist the questions beyond the daemon's cache; a restart asks again (S143).
5. Docs: the status section of `docs/design.md` and `docs/guide.md`, citing the new record. Changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S340 --text "..."`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- After a spec check leaves open questions, ork status counts them in needs you and lists the item, its question keys and the command that lists them, in text and JSON.
- An item with all questions answered, a changed spec, or questions waiting on an adj record is not listed.
- Answering stays with ork wave start and ork run --answer.

Commands:
- `go test ./internal/daemon ./internal/cli -run 'StatusCountsOpenSpecQuestions|StatusSpecQuestions|StatusPrintsOpenSpecQuestions' -v`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch, message "S340: ork status lists open spec-check questions".
